blocks.text: CARACAS — Embattled Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth arrived in Colombia Wednesday, after he made a surprise appearance in Caracas for the highest-level US visit since the January ouster of president Nicolas Maduro. Colombia has traditionally been one of the United States’ closest allies in the region, and the visit comes as Washington and Bogota discuss carrying out joint military operations against drug-trafficking groups. “In each country, according to each country’s laws but in working together, we are going to find, we are going to hunt, we are going to kill and defeat narcoterrorists,” Hegseth said standing alongside Colombian ministers.
